QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent I
QuestInfo.0: Vicky is mad at Vincent for trying to bribe the judges. She may be a good singer, but can she really hope to enter the audition on skill alone? Talk to Vicky.
QuestInfo.1: Vicky says she will let Vincent handle the band's styling. You want to put someone more responsible in charge... but don't want to hurt Vincent's feelings and inform him anyway.
QuestInfo.2: Vincent was super happy to learn he's been put in charge of styling. Oh no... what hideous horrors will he unleash?

0.0: I don't have time for stupid bribes! I need to keep practicing or I won't win the audition!
0.1: Plus, I still haven't decided what I'm gonna wear... and my hair... and my perfume... How about you go tell Vincent to help me?

yes.0: That's what I thought. You don't have a choice. You HAVE to help me.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: What's that? Vicky wants me to help with her audition preparations? Woo hoo! She finally noticed I exist!

yes.0: Hooray! I get to be Vicky's stylist for the day!
yes.1: Someday they'll make a movie about us. I can see it now: a sordid love affair between a singer and her handsome manager! It'll win an Oscar, I tell you!

npc.0: Tell Vincent to get me ready for my auditions.
